# `resource-cleanup-on-error-only`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a resource cleaned up by `errdefer` only, with no successful-path
cleanup or ownership transfer.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Error paths release the resource, but successful calls retain it
unintentionally.

## When it fires

It applies to recognized resource constructors and release methods in a simple
lexical scope.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn load(dir: std.fs.Dir, name: []const u8) !void {
    const file = try dir.openFile(name, .{});
    errdefer file.close();
    try process();
}

fn process() !void {}
```
